title: Combine Harvester
subtitle: Cuts, threshes, separates and cleans a field of grain in one pass
scale: ≈ 7 m header · 300 hp · 10 t grain tank
summary: A combine does four jobs at once: it cuts the crop, beats the grain out of the ears, separates it from the straw, and cleans it with air. The header gathers the stalks, the threshing drum knocks the grain loose, the straw walkers carry the straw away, and sieves shake the grain clean before an auger lifts it into the tank.

parts.name: Chassis
parts.short: The frame that carries every system
parts.detail: A welded frame on two axles. It carries the header, threshing body, grain tank and engine.

parts.name: Body Panels
parts.short: Close the threshing and cleaning area
parts.detail: Removable side panels keep dust in and let technicians reach the drum and sieves.

parts.name: Operator Cab
parts.short: The driver's control room above the header
parts.detail: A sealed cab with a wide view of the header. The operator controls speed, height and separation from here.

parts.name: Access Ladder
parts.detail: Steps with handrails lead from the ground to the cab door.

parts.name: Header and Cutter Bar
parts.short: Cuts the crop at the stem
parts.detail: A wide frame carries a reciprocating cutter bar. Hydraulic cylinders raise and lower it to follow the ground.

parts.name: Reel
parts.short: Bends the crop into the cutter bar
parts.detail: Five bats sweep the stems backward so the knife cuts them cleanly and the auger can gather them.

parts.name: Header Auger
parts.short: Gathers cut crop toward the centre
parts.detail: A screw with retractable fingers moves the cut stems to the feeder house.

parts.name: Feeder House
parts.short: Lifts the crop into the threshing drum
parts.detail: A sloping duct with a chain conveyor feeds the crop upward at a controlled rate.

parts.name: Threshing Drum and Concave
parts.short: Beats the grain out of the ears
parts.detail: Rasp bars on the drum rub the crop against the concave. Most grain falls through the concave; straw carries on.

parts.name: Straw Walkers
parts.short: Shake loose grain out of the straw
parts.detail: Stepped bars carry straw to the rear while shaking remaining grain through to the cleaning shoe.

parts.name: Cleaning Fan and Sieves
parts.short: Blows chaff away from the grain
parts.detail: A cross-flow fan lifts light chaff while sieves shake the grain through. Clean grain falls to the auger.

parts.name: Grain Tank
parts.detail: A large tank above the threshing body. The operator empties it before it gets heavy enough to affect stability.

parts.name: Grain Auger
parts.detail: A screw conveyor at the bottom of the cleaning shoe carries clean grain up into the tank.

parts.name: Unloading Auger
parts.short: Empties the tank into a trailer
parts.detail: A long folding auger swings out and discharges grain while the combine keeps moving.

parts.name: Engine and Cooling
parts.short: Powers the drive, drum and hydraulics
parts.detail: A diesel engine drives the wheels, threshing and hydraulic pumps. The radiator and exhaust sit at the rear.

parts.name: Chaff Spreader
parts.detail: A spinning disc throws chaff and short straw across the field for even residue cover.

parts.name: Wheels and Axles
parts.short: Carry the machine over the field
parts.detail: Large front drive wheels carry most of the weight; smaller rear wheels steer.

parts.name: Lights and Nameplate
parts.detail: Work lights allow harvesting after dark. The nameplate records the model and serial number.

steps.title: The header gathers the crop
steps.body: The reel bends stems toward the cutter bar, the knife cuts them, and the auger sweeps them into the feeder house.

steps.title: The drum threshes
steps.body: The rotating drum rubs the crop against the concave. Grain loosens from the ears and falls through, while straw continues over the top.

steps.title: Straw and grain separate
steps.body: Straw walkers shake the straw to recover grain, then carry the straw out the back. The grain falls onto the cleaning shoe.

steps.title: Air cleans the grain
steps.body: The fan blows chaff sideways while the sieves shake grain through. Clean grain drops to the auger and is lifted into the tank.

Tap the part that beats grain out of the ears.

What do the straw walkers do?
choices: Shake loose grain out of the straw
quiz.explain: They carry straw rearward while shaking remaining grain through to the cleaning shoe.

quiz.prompt: Why does the unloading auger fold out?
choices: To empty the grain tank into a trailer
quiz.explain: The auger reaches sideways so a trailer can receive grain while the combine keeps harvesting.
